formal_ambiguity.exact_text: The term “integrated onto” describes the relationship between the card exiled by the integrate ability and the permanent chosen when the spell represented by that card resolves
formal_ambiguity.conflict: 701.76a and all reminder variants require exile then immediate optional host selection. Library, graveyard, battlefield and permanent-spell sources do not all later resolve as a spell. No delayed resolution timing is inferred.

subrules.name: 701.76a
subrules.rule: Some abilities instruct a player to integrate a card or permanent. To do so, exile it, then for each card the object was represented by exiled this way, you may choose any nonland permanent.

subrules.name: 701.76b
subrules.rule: The term “integrated onto” describes the relationship between the card exiled by the integrate ability and the permanent chosen when the spell represented by that card resolves

subrules.name: 701.76c
subrules.rule: The exiled card remains integrated onto the chosen permanent as long as the integrated card remains exiled and the permanent remains on the battlefield. The card remains integrated onto that object even if it changes controller, as long as it remains on the battlefield.

mechanics.original_reminder: Exile it, then you may choose a nonland permanent it's integrated onto.
mechanics.executable_reminder: Exile {Object}. For each card exiled this way, do the following: [You may do the following: [Choose a nonland permanent; Link the iterated card to the chosen permanent under the integrated relationship.]].

subrules.name: 701.76a
subrules.rule: Some abilities instruct a player to integrate a card or permanent. To do so, exile it, then for each card the object was represented by exiled this way, you may choose any nonland permanent.

subrules.name: 701.76b
subrules.rule: The term “integrated onto” describes the relationship between the card exiled by the integrate ability and the permanent chosen when the spell represented by that card resolves

subrules.name: 701.76c
subrules.rule: The exiled card remains integrated onto the chosen permanent as long as the integrated card remains exiled and the permanent remains on the battlefield. The card remains integrated onto that object even if it changes controller, as long as it remains on the battlefield.
